bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (COVID-19 Economic Response) Bill 2021

name: The majority voted in favour of *disagreeing* with the amendment to the usual [second reading](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/) motion, which is that the bill be read a second time - parliamentary jargon for agreeing with the main idea of the bill. This means that the amendment failed. ### Amendment text > *That all words after "That" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:* > > *"whilst not declining to give the bill a second reading, the House recognises that Australia's economic recovery from the COVID-19 crisis has been hurt by the Government's failure to:* > >> *(1) roll out the vaccine;* >> >> *(2) deliver an effective national quarantine system; and* >> >> *(3) promote wage growth"*
